status: pinned public source integration; support is scoped by signed board/firmware release reports

m1n1.policy: owner explicitly authorizes AI-assisted maintenance under the downstream AGENTS.md

uboot.policy: retain target distribution package for first milestone; record exact package version and hash per qualified release

boot_chain_constraints.policy: J613 DTBs containing the disabled internal Type-C route must accompany a kernel descended from this commit. Assemble kernel and DTBs from the same locked source revision.
boot_chain_constraints.external_display_firmware: Exactly three u32 cells: 14 7 0. The paired kernel has no J613 external-display support on 26.6.2; camera support is separate.
boot_chain_constraints.profile: Normal kernel display path only. Both display gates depend on !SILICONFOREST_M3; the alternative M3 copies intentionally have no T8122/J613 support.
boot_chain_constraints.panel_phy_dependency: The panel waits for atcphy1. The 25G83 tree includes t8122-j613.dts, so this dependency and the kernel pairing floor apply to both DTBs.

handoff.apple,t8122-dcpext-firmware-ready: u32 = 1, published only after successful firmware reservation and version publication
handoff.status: dcpext, DARTs, mailbox and route crossbars remain disabled; the kernel gate enables the group in one changeset

rollback.old_loader_new_kernel: No readiness marker; external-display gate refuses activation.
rollback.new_loader_old_kernel: External controller remains disabled; use that kernel's matching older DTB.
rollback.new_dtb_old_kernel: Unsupported: the older panel driver rejects the new Type-C route container and the J613 panel goes down.
